method: 34 observations; overlapping evidence retained, consolidated into 18 proposed decisions. P0 indicates planning/launch risk, not measured production incident.

findings.title: Two competing creation paths and contracts (confirmed STATIC)
findings.detail:
Sources: `controller.js:99`, `calm.mjs:23`, `workbench.mjs:100–103`, `guided.mjs:25–34`, `controller.js:198`, persona `applyPulseAction`.
Issue: same +Project intent leads to guided 4-step flow or advanced workbench; capabilities differ (repository suggestions/templates/independent draft list/reconciliation vs scan/guide). Completion lands in different home. The user must learn entry points, not just a product concept.
Decision: one draft domain and one primary entry; preserve advanced configuration as a subordinate module, route all creation affordances through the same coordinator. Preserve old deep links as aliases, not remove features.
Impact: route model, model journey links, SCN031/059, FLW18/32, SCR27, guided/workbench/controller, persona transitions, fixtures and exact route tests.
Acceptance: every create affordance yields same draft identity/schema; changing path cannot lose fields; source modes and optional configs reconcile; success same Project+receipt; previous deep links still work; keyboard/mobile entry and return verified.

findings.title: Choosing idea still deduplicates against previous repository (confirmed EXEC handler probe)
findings.detail:
Sources: `guided.mjs:42,47`, `controller.js:197`.
Repro: enter existing repo `/archived`; switch mode to idea; create. `g.repo` remains `/archived`, before repoMode none is applied the duplicate check finds archived Project and blocks creation. Output: `{mode:"idea",repo:"/archived",created:0,archive:"old"}`.
Decision: retain per-mode field drafts if useful, but derive effective source before review, duplicate check and create; idea has no repository identity. Review and command must share exactly that effective source.
Impact: source-mode draft schema + dedupe + review; canonical source identity also needed for URL/path aliases.
Acceptance: single→idea with existing/archived repo creates repo-free idea; idea→single restores optional draft but requires explicit attachment; path whitespace/alias/case/symlink identity tested at runtime resolver, no UI guess.

findings.title: Native restarted draft IDs can collide and overwrite restored work (STATIC strong code finding, native DOM test not run)
findings.detail:
Sources: `App.tsx:193,232,402–405`. `draftSeq` starts at 0, restored disk keys not used to seed it; newDraft writes `draft-1` with object spread overwrite. Existing persistence test fixture uses `tab-1`, not realistic generated `draft-1` (`onboardingDraft.persist.test.tsx:34`).
Decision: UUID draft identity or allocator collision-proof over restored/in-flight IDs; restore and create must not race. Keep project UUID identity separate.
Acceptance: restore dirty draft-1 and draft-2, click new draft twice, all old fields+project IDs unchanged; separate tabs unique; restart preserves all; no create before hydration overwrites pending disk state. Test actual shell event, not standalone counter.

findings.title: No dedicated value checkpoint/return loop in current guided path (PROPOSED product gap)
findings.detail:
Sources: `guided.mjs:34,49–51`; foundation ST039/040 and vision progressive adoption. Guide completion is Project+Task+tutorial topic, not demonstrated context recovery.
Decision: two cohort routes: existing work → sourced orientation and one next action; idea → saved intent/checkpoint. Define first value and first return evidence independently from feature lesson completion.
Impact: read adapters/source coverage, context capsule, read/ack checkpoint, attention feed, guide progression, event schema and privacy-conscious measurement. Never fabricate delta when no history or unread sources.
Acceptance: user can answer goal/current state/next decision from own source card; source link exact; unknown shown; return after one new event highlights it once only after acknowledgement; routine heartbeat alone cannot qualify.

findings.title: Guide completion can mark Board learned without reading/resolving it (confirmed STATIC; existing EXEC test deliberately accepts mere IDs)
findings.detail:
Sources: `guided.mjs:34,50,51`; `scripts/test/calm-flows.test.mjs:6` onward.
Decision: distinguish created/read/applied/skipped. Prefer first real Board outcome. If tutorial, separate learning record with `tutorial` provenance; do not include in meaningful progress metrics.
Impact: GuideProgress event/projection, Board outcome linkage, deletion/supersession/replay handling, pulse filters.
Acceptance: creating topic alone does not mark learned; navigate away/skip distinct; real resolved item can satisfy objective once; delete item doesn't delete user's Task; no fabricated production evidence or points.

findings.title: Skip hides obvious exact resumption (STATIC discoverability gap)
findings.detail:
Sources: `guided.mjs:51`, `controller.js:161`, `guided.mjs:19,22`.
Decision: separate passive-nudge dismissal from feature accessibility. Help exposes “Продолжить знакомство с <Project>” with exact progress; plus explicit restart optional. Never force creation of second Project to resume lessons.
Acceptance: skip at every step→navigate other Project→help resume restores original Estate/Project/revision/draft; archived/ACL loss safe; no repeated automatic nudge after opt-out; request to resume clears only relevant dismissal.

findings.title: “Настроить позже” still creates Builder candidate with provider `later` (STATIC)
findings.detail:
Sources: `guided.mjs:27`; `new-project.mjs:7`; `operations.mjs:355–359`.
Issue: domain treats UI sentinel `later` as provider identity; Project contains unverified Builder/session/binding rows though user deferred executor. Native default agent is Claude Code even when options unavailable (`onboardingDraft.ts:52`).
Decision: represent no executor as null/pending role, never a fake Provider. If default role scaffolding is intentional, label it unfilled and create no provider/binding/session until selection. Resolve ST001 “exactly one PM” vs progressive idea-only semantics explicitly.
Acceptance: defer→no provider ID later, no runnable session/binding; creation still allowed; next needed action offers setup; selecting real candidate preserves original Project and Task; authority remains explicit.

findings.title: Guided chat shortcut can write draft to a different thread than currently shown (STATIC hypothesis requiring browser/controller test)
findings.detail:
Sources: `controller.js:30,32,46`; `guided.mjs:48`.
Issue: override chat scope within same route; guided chat shortcut computes assistantScope(view,state) ignoring scopeOverride, writes there, then assistantUI.render honours still-valid override. User sees old/empty draft while intended prompt exists in another thread.
Decision: one context resolver for display and all composer mutations. Explicit object shortcut either announces/pins destination or respects current scope; no silent split.
Acceptance: on guide Project A choose chat Project B/global then invoke guided example; displayed scope and draft destination agree; no overwrite other draft; cancelled speech/attachments remain scoped; send creates no wrong-project artifact.

findings.title: Native retry of same Project ID doesn't validate changed create payload (STATIC contract gap)
findings.detail:
Sources: `apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts:1064–1067`; `Onboarding.tsx:61–69`.
Issue: existing ID returns old name/purpose while attaches whatever repo list is supplied on retry. After partial/unknown create, edited retry silently combines original intent and new repositories. UI currently generic error and editable draft.
Decision: immutable pending create command+payload fingerprint, reconcile before edited submission; user chooses explicit post-create update for new values. Do not infer from already-exists success that current fields were saved.
Acceptance: lost create response + changed name/purpose/repos yields conflict/review, not silent success; same request identical payload idempotent; partial attachments reconciliation exact; authorization rechecked. Backend/native integration required.

findings.title: First conversation prompt asks for “changes since last visit” before any visit/history (STATIC UX mismatch)
findings.detail:
Sources: `guided.mjs:48`; first-task suggestion `guided.mjs:34`.
Decision: starter prompt based on observed phase: existing source→“Помоги понять, где остановились”; idea→“Помоги уточнить первый результат”; returning→delta since known checkpoint. No imperative launch promise.
Acceptance: new idea no-history message says known unknown and offers next step; imported source cites actual source; returning digest uses cutoff; actions explicitly preview destination.

findings.title: Guided creation lacks explicit pending/refused/unknown result branch (STATIC target gap)
findings.detail:
Sources: `guided.mjs:47`; global state screen `guided.mjs:16`; compare workbench `controller.js:250,259–260`.
Issue: prototype create callback synchronous, no receipt affordance at point of success, no retry identity display/reconciliation on guided route. Global simulated error is not command-state recovery. Current synchronous prototype means no actual async failure claimed.
Decision: same command coordinator for both creation entries; pending/unknown held, same request reconcile, back/read-only with draft preserved.
Acceptance: late success after navigating away doesn't switch wrong tab; duplicate click no sibling; async refusal retained; unknown refresh finds same Project; cancelled scan never creates.

findings.title: Canonical onboarding acceptance and newer target refinements conflict (STATIC documentation contract drift)
findings.detail:
Sources: `scenarios.md:810–829` (memory/default agent/multi-folder full setup, saved configured), `scenarios.md:1552–1574` (durable optional intent), `scenarios.md:2353–2355` (source-first guided), foundation ST001 exactly PM vs deferred candidate.
Decision: consolidated current normative contract with superseded details clearly marked; retain dated history. Distinguish current production implementation, target and tested prototype in each packet.
Acceptance: same allowed prerequisites/required fields/landing/command states everywhere; map/SCN/FLW/SCR/model links resolve; historical receipts unchanged; no status upgrade from mockup traversal.

findings.title: New personal Home still shows Atlas/Studio activity
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: `launch.mjs:58–68` appends fixed Atlas/Studio Live rows regardless of owned projects; `launch.mjs:18–22` correctly resets personal project/topic data but not this feed. Pure render TEST with sole personal project `own` returned `newPersonalHomeShowsAtlas:true`, `newPersonalHomeShowsStudio:true`, ownedProjects `[own]`.
- Affects SCN-059/060/090/094. First user can believe somebody else's work belongs to them; the honest empty/first-work state is lost.
- Decision A (recommended): estate-scoped observation read model, explicit sample dataset only behind “Посмотреть пример”. B: keep sample alongside empty state but label the entire sample region and disable real-work actions; inferior for first real project.
- Impact: Home feed + Pulse + Board counts + fixtures + estate filtering + generated previews. Do not patch only the two displayed names.
- Negative checks: one fresh personal project → no Atlas/Studio name, IDs, links or activity counters; archive/remove last project; switch estate while feed paused; missing source ≠ zero activity.

findings.title: Home resume cannot recover the exact work or a true since-last-visit delta
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: `launch.mjs:57` selects `lastProject`, then latest `launchData.events`, with Atlas fixed “3 изменения”; button always opens project overview. `launch.mjs:73` sets lastProject only when rendering launch-project. Operations has independent history and mark at `operations.mjs:34,73,198`. `controller.js:34` inserts chat messages into launch events, not operation lifecycle.
- Affects SCN-040/045/060/090/093/094. Visiting Task/Run directly, switching project, answering or completing work can produce a resume card that knows neither exact entity nor measured delta. A chat reply may replace the meaningful next step.
- Decision A (recommended): one ReturnSnapshot contract keyed estate/project/user: source cursor, seen cursor, exact continuation ref, pending operator decision, next permitted action, coverage/age, observed state. Home compact projection; Project expanded projection; CEO same snapshot. B: call existing card “Последний открытый проект” and defer promise of context return (does not deliver core launch value).
- Impact: durable read cursor and journal, Home/Project/CEO/notifications, session restore, origin routing, cache invalidation. “Continue” must not mark unrelated updates read.
- Negative checks: Task/Run direct deep link updates continuation; two projects retain distinct marks; new event after render but before leave remains unread; refresh failure keeps prior age; deleted/inaccessible target recovers without another project's substitution.

findings.title: Return shortcut is a count summary, not the promised return insight
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC/TEST: `assistant.mjs:57` suggests “Собери изменения с прошлого визита”; `concierge.mjs:41–43` returns project purpose + total tasks + open question count and one project link. Pure test returned “Only my project: First value. В снимке 0 задач; открытых вопросов — 0.” No visit cursor/decisions/what changed/next step.
- Affects SCN-042/090/093, guide first chat. Current guide promises first value through a query unable to demonstrate it (`guided.mjs:48`).
- Decision: reuse RET-02 snapshot instead of separate NLU-specific summary. On truly first visit say no previous checkpoint, show sourced imported context or capture a first checkpoint. Never invent “changes since visit.”
- Impact: read service, CEO answer schema and source links, guide milestones, telemetry definitions.
- Negative checks: first visit, no changes, stale/partial observation, empty journal, unresolved blocker, changed decision, answer sources all in exact allowed scope.

findings.title: Task link correction is exposed but wired to Board-topic relinking
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: saved task card exposes “Уточнить связь” (`assistant.mjs:38`); handler `save-link` at 55 invokes controller `onRelink` (`controller.js:35`), which always calls `relinkLaunchArtifact`; that function only finds `d.topics` entry `ceo:<artifact.id>` (`launch.mjs:31`). Task path `controller.js:41` creates only operations Task.
- Pure TEST: relink of saved task proposal returned `{ok:false,error:"Исходная запись не найдена"}`. Existing tests cover references and task creation but not this callback chain.
- Affects SCN-042/045 and conversation attribution. The visible feature cannot finish its purpose for the only artifact type where it is shown.
- Decision A: explicit attribution command shared by Task and Board, typed entityRef + immutable original origin + append-only link change receipt. B: remove Task relink until supported and preserve original attribution; do not leave failing control.
- Impact: command contracts, artifact provenance, task timeline, conversation card, authorization and cross-project rejection.
- Negative checks: existing task same project succeeds; blank allowed/unlink policy explicit; foreign task refuses; same request repeat no duplicate receipt; archived project refuses write; original message origin unchanged.

findings.title: design gap — Product run controls force operator through low-level runner stages
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: ordinary primary Run actions include “Создать процесс”, “Доставить инструкцию”, “Сверить адресную доставку”, “Подтвердить остановку”, “Checker: принять результат” (`operations.mjs:118–127`). Handlers mutate simulated process/checker facts (`244–251`). Fault injection is disclosed, but these normal source transitions still look like operator responsibilities.
- Affects SCN-052/067; contrary to user request that agents handle routine mechanics. Useful simulator, incomplete production UX contract.
- Decision A: one explicit “Начать работу” after scoped readiness, automatic process/admission/delivery/checker state machine, visible stop/retry/reconcile only when operator action required. Observations are read-only; simulator controls explicitly marked. B: expert console retains manual steps behind advanced mode, never default onboarding.
- Impact: orchestrator/admission/host observation, Run state projection, buttons and labels, permissions, integration tests. Preserve admission ≠ acknowledgement ≠ independent acceptance as data even when automation hides mechanical steps.
- Negative checks: duplicate start; uncertain delivery does not resend; unknown stop never shows stopped; checker absent/author cannot award acceptance; partial artifacts survive retry; UI offers only actions supported by current server capabilities.

findings.title: Deferred Board topic has no explicit return trigger
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: defer requires text then sets only status `later` (`launch.mjs:32–36,84`). Home shows only `open` (`70`); Board offers Later filter (`71`). No due date/trigger/next-review contract in topic model.
- Affects SCN-041/093. “На следующий раз” can disappear indefinitely unless user remembers to inspect a separate tab; hook lacks reliable reason to return.
- Decision A: “Следующий разбор” as default explicit trigger, optional date/event in details, resurfacing receipt and dedupe. B: rename “Отложить без напоминания” and show deferred count on return. Avoid silently scheduled reminders without user choice.
- Impact: attention read model, daily review/session boundary, scheduler optionally, Board status versus resurfacing event, notification consent.
- Negative checks: once-only resurfacing, overdue/no source, archived project, skipped review, many deferrals, clear distinction task priority vs personal attention.

findings.title: Shortcut/example overwrites a user's unsent draft
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: `assistant.mjs:57` assigns `t.draft` for any suggest action without retaining old text; `controller.js:46` guide examples also assign t.draft. Scope switching itself retains drafts, so this is a different loss path.
- Affects SCN-042/059. Need not ask a modal each time: recommendation insert example only into empty draft, otherwise offer append/replace with immediate Undo and retain original.
- Impact: common composer draft reducer for shortcuts, examples, voice transcript and contextual actions; ownership by scope and revision.
- Negative checks: typed draft → shortcut → Undo; switching scope during shortcut; voice draft and attachments preserved; repeated shortcut does not pile up duplicate text.

findings.title: Default voice example requests a compound action but executes only Board read
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: transcript at `assistant.mjs:60` = “Собери изменения с прошлого визита и вынеси вопросы на доску.” Classifier uses first regex match, Board precedes Context (`concierge.mjs:12–13,32`); TEST returns `{id:board,mode:read}`. No summary or Board write occurs.
- Affects SCN-042/093, voice introduction. Misleading first voice experience even within labeled demo.
- Decision A: first voice example one supported read intent; explicitly preview multi-intent plan later and execute typed commands with separate receipts. B: recognize compound intent and clearly state which part is unsupported, never imply completion.
- Impact: capability routing, action plan schema, tutorial examples, partial completion and retry contract.
- Negative checks: compound command partial failure; clarify missing destination; read success/write refusal; no duplicate topic on retry; transcription edits preserve original and final text attribution.

findings.title: Returning digest acknowledges current total, not the exact displayed boundary
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: `operations.mjs:73` renders sorted newest-first rows and uses count equality; navigation at `operations.mjs:191` and `controller.js:136` writes current history length. SCN-090 (`scenarios.md:2163–2182`) requires oldest-first and acknowledgement of exactly the visible reading, including sources arriving during view.
- Affects SCN-090. No event-stream browser reproduction claimed; static callback is susceptible if history grows between render and leave. Counts also fail on reordering/backfill.
- Decision: immutable render receipt with source head/cursor, visibility rule and monotonic acknowledgement. Preserve currently approved leaving-ack behavior, but use rendered receipt, not current length. Unify with RET-02.
- Impact: every navigation route, digest polling, active-pane visibility, background tabs, stream append/backfill, persistent marks.
- Negative checks: event appended after last render, late/backfilled event, failed head, switching task while digest hidden, double return no repeated old rows, source reordering.

findings.title: Session tutorial measures setup records instead of demonstrated return value
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: guide completion gate is task+topic (`guided.mjs:51`); guide progress counts project/task/topic/finished (`34`). It neither requires handling the tutorial topic nor a context switch/second visit nor actual result. Created topic at `50` instructs user to close it but completion does not depend on that.
- Affects SCN-059/060/090. User can finish the entire guide without experiencing the core promise, while tutorial itself adds a noisy attention item.
- Decision A: milestones are actual outcomes: scope known → first checkpoint/context digest saved → first useful action → leave/return comparison → real attention resolution. Task/topic records remain analytics but not activation. B: retain setup checklist labeled setup, add separate voluntary first-value path. No artificial blocker on work if skipped.
- Impact: onboarding state machine, ReturnSnapshot, analytics cohorts, tutorial Board metadata/priority, empty project path vs imported existing project path.
- Negative checks: skip never advances milestone; deleted task doesn't erase historical success but invalidates continuation; archived project suspends prompts; manual completion outside guide counts; no re-show after dismissal unless meaningful trigger.

findings.title: Missing conversation deep link silently falls back to current scope
findings.detail:
- Evidence STATIC: `controller.js:30` overrides context only if matching conversation is found; otherwise it uses current scope, with no “conversation missing” state. Threads are in-memory Map (`assistant.mjs:7,14`); source links are shareable hash params (`launch.mjs:42`).
- Affects SCN-040/042/060 and durable conversation requirement. Existing empty thread can appear in place of expected source conversation after refresh or missing data.
- Decision: explicit unresolved/missing/denied source-link state that preserves requested identity and offers current scope as separate action. Durable history later uses same contract.
- Impact: route parser, conversation resolver, source citations, reload/session restoration, access revocation, snapshots.
- Negative checks: missing conversation, wrong estate, deleted project, partial history, inaccessible original, message missing within existing conversation. Never substitute another message.

findings.title: Traceability parser absorbs unrelated appendices
findings.detail: `scripts/sync-product-ux.mjs:11` slices a registry record until the next *same-prefix* `###`, or EOF; `:18` collects every SCN occurrence in that body. Therefore SCR-63 inherits SCN-094/042/031/059 from general appendices beginning `docs/ux/screens.md:1356`, although its declared Scenarios field at `:1336` only lists SCN-083/084/085/087/088/089. The same boundary function parses scenarios and flows, so final SCN/FLW records need checks too. **Red regression run (exit 1):** assert that references extracted from SCR-63's parser slice exclude SCN-031; actual references were `083,084,085,087,088,089,094,042,031,059`. Repair packet before trusting downstream auto coverage: bound record at next equal-or-higher heading, parse own fields, model general appendices as explicit overrides keyed to named records; preserve legitimate inverse references. Do not raise canonical status on resync.

findings.proposed_acceptance: Add a real regression for final SCN/FLW/SCR record boundaries and explicit global appendix refinements. Old parser must fail; fixed parser preserves legitimate IDs/aliases/statuses and no longer attaches SCN-031 to SCR-63. Regenerate model and check all 85 views without changing runtime coverage.

findings.title: Required R0 capabilities and later catalogue screens need narrower contracts
findings.detail: OX-09/10 are R0 at `docs/ux/plans/2026-09-15-r0-operator.md:74–75`, but providers/admission/routine-editor/pipeline are later model views. `docs/ux/screens.md:1403–1404` already distinguishes basic config from advanced gates. Decision: define one admitted preset setup and one paused review-cycle preset as R0 journeys, reuse advanced details only when needed. Do not infer that later editor permits bypassing admission, cost or authority.

Do not infer that later editor permits bypassing admission, cost or authority.
findings.proposed_acceptance: Demonstrate first admitted executable preset and first paused cycle preset without opening full provider catalogue/DAG editor. Scope, budget, compatibility/admission, save versus enable and observed state remain explicit; later advanced screens cannot bypass these gates.

findings.title: Runtime account setup cannot be a universal first-use gate
findings.detail: `docs/ux/scenarios.md:2109`, `:2126`, `:2160` say ProviderAccounts component has tests but no reachable runtime IPC/settings entry; M199 stays proposed at `docs/evidence/backlog.md:767`. `apps/desktop/src/shared/providerCapabilityMatrix.ts:10–22` records explicit capability/certification limitations (version-specific historical evidence, not a claim about today's external product). New users need system-login/read-only/manual-task path; managed second account and cross-account continuity introduced only when capability is actually certified. Never promise live resume from prototype account-switch.

Never promise live resume from prototype account-switch.
findings.proposed_acceptance: A user without managed provider accounts can create/read a project and save a task, using certified system login only when executing. Unsupported second-account and resume paths explain limitation and leave original session intact. No provider capability claimed from fixture success.

findings.title: Teaching collaboration must disclose estate-wide visibility before invitation
findings.detail: `apps/desktop/src/shared/membership.ts:129–154` explicitly says v1 sees the whole estate; renderer filters cannot manufacture project-only membership. Model SCR-14 description reports no invitation/acceptance renderer; canonical `docs/ux/screens.md:302`. Give invited users separate entry/intent, existing work restoration and role-specific actions. Do not show “invite to this project only” absent enforced contract.

Model SCR-14 description reports no invitation/acceptance renderer; canonical `docs/ux/screens.md:302`. Give invited users separate entry/intent, existing work restoration and role-specific actions. Do not show “invite to this project only” absent enforced contract.
findings.proposed_acceptance: Before invite, show actual estate-wide visibility and current role; invited member resumes exact invitation after auth. No project-only access claim unless trusted boundary enforces it; denied/revoked invitation hides data without widening scope.

findings.title: Recurring-value hook must respect desktop availability
findings.detail: `apps/desktop/src/main/routineTick.ts:16–20` says closed app runs nothing, with bounded catch-up; future cycle overview is not proof of background service. Teaching “come back tomorrow, Fabric worked” is invalid without actual receipts. Preview next due + host requirement, then first real completed window, then pause/recovery. Pause feed is distinct from pause schedule and stop current run (OX plan `:28–32`).

Teaching “come back tomorrow, Fabric worked” is invalid without actual receipts. Preview next due + host requirement, then first real completed window, then pause/recovery. Pause feed is distinct from pause schedule and stop current run (OX plan `:28–32`).
findings.proposed_acceptance: Preview host availability and timezone/next window before enabling. Close desktop through due time and reopen: show bounded catch-up and real window receipts, not fabricated background progress. Pause display, schedule and current run separately.

findings.title: Current guide is one linear setup, not a cross-session adoption system
findings.detail: `scripts/product/guided.mjs:7–11` is an in-memory Map and fixed four steps; `:29` explicitly limits retention to page lifetime; `docs/launch/ceo-onboarding.md:47` describes future GuideRecord but no entry/trigger policy for later capabilities. Add durable per-user+estate+project adoption state with eligibility triggers, dismiss/resume, source receipts and independent feature availability. Session number is guidance, not a lock or streak obligation.

Add durable per-user+estate+project adoption state with eligibility triggers, dismiss/resume, source receipts and independent feature availability. Session number is guidance, not a lock or streak obligation.
findings.proposed_acceptance: Guide survives relaunch and switching projects/estate without losing draft, changing destination or recreating task. Dismiss/skip independent from completion; introduction policy uses actual event eligibility, not compulsory elapsed days.

findings.title: “Learning completed” conflates object creation with experienced value
findings.detail: `scripts/product/guided.mjs:34` counts task/topic IDs; `:50` creates an educational Board topic; `:51` marks finished once both exist. User could complete without resolving the topic or returning after a pause. Keep setup receipts separate from first-value, first-return and learning evidence; never invent learning from a click. Educational topic must be visibly tutorial, removable/skippable and never outrank real obligations.
findings.full_text: 7. **P1 · “Learning completed” conflates object creation with experienced value.** `scripts/product/guided.mjs:34` counts task/topic IDs; `:50` creates an educational Board topic; `:51` marks finished once both exist. User could complete without resolving the topic or returning after a pause. Keep setup receipts separate from first-value, first-return and learning evidence; never invent learning from a click. Educational topic must be visibly tutorial, removable/skippable and never outrank real obligations.
findings.proposed_acceptance: First-value receipt names real saved/read/accepted result; learning completion requires evidence of the intended task, distinct from creating a tutorial row. User may skip/remove tutorial without affecting real task/permissions; tutorial never outranks critical obligation.

findings.title: Synthetic default cycles can contaminate empty-project learning
findings.detail: `scripts/product/routines.mjs:24–25` seeds “Проверка уроков” with a three-node fixture graph for every project; `:28–30` clones it when user proposes a cycle. This is explicitly a simulator (`:1`), but guided new-project demonstrations need genuine empty state and explicit preset preview so they do not teach that a real new project already has configured work. Verify new project→cycles with no fixture graft before accepting prototype flow; do not treat this as a proven runtime bug.

Verify new project→cycles with no fixture graft before accepting prototype flow; do not treat this as a proven runtime bug.
findings.proposed_acceptance: New own project with no configured routines opens a genuine empty cycle view; explicit preset preview precedes saving a paused routine. Do not clone unrelated demo graph/history implicitly; retain demo fixtures only in clearly chosen example cohort.

findings.title: Full catalogue remains reachable as 85-item mobile control
findings.detail: `scripts/product/calm.mjs:23` renders all model views in mobile select and “Все разделы · 85” for every cohort. Good for design review, unsuitable as default novice IA. Separate preview controls from proposed product shell; use progressive suggested entries plus stable search, never remove recovery or experienced-user direct navigation. Map/editor aliases should not become extra concepts to learn.

findings.proposed_acceptance: Novice product shell excludes review-only catalogue/control noise but preserves help, search/direct expert access and emergency recovery. Mobile novice journey does not require choosing among 85 demo views; aliases count as one concept.

findings.title: Conversational discovery is currently a deterministic catalogue, not general manager execution
findings.detail: `scripts/product/concierge.mjs:1–32` regex routes to forms; `:42–43` explicitly says changes are not applied and link to common form. Define each introduced shortcut by intent→scope→prerequisite→command/read→receipt→next action. User should get value after click, not a tour of a form that cannot act. Unsupported/freeform clarification must preserve draft and give exact fallback, not silently create a task.

findings.proposed_acceptance: For each introduced chat shortcut test intent, exact scope, required capability, dispatched shared handler, receipt and next action. Form-only intent says no change yet; unknown intent preserves draft, asks bounded clarification and creates no hidden task.

findings.title: Learnable system requires meaningful unit receipts, not all-screen smoke
findings.detail: `docs/ux/audits/2026-09-16-calm-ui.md:11` disclaims full-operation coverage. SCN registry `docs/ux/scenarios.md:39–98` remains partial/blocked/fail/unobserved. Test first-time novice with no seeded tasks/agents/conversations and distinct invited/existing/new-idea cohorts, then leave/relaunch and verify correct next action. Existing green prototype tests do not certify value or production readiness.

decisions.title: Сначала исправить доказательную карту
decisions.choice: Не доверять ошибочной автоматической связи SCR/SCN. Ограничить разделы, проверить явные и обратные ссылки; сохранить исторические статусы.
decisions.alternative: Оставить нынешний зелёный --check: отвергнуто, он проверяет воспроизводимость ошибки.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Один вход и один черновик проекта
decisions.choice: Все +Проект и deep links ведут в один coordinator. Дополнительные настройки раскрываются в нём; у всех входов одинаковые identity, review, исход и восстановление.
decisions.alternative: Удалить старый вход: отвергнуто, потеряет ссылки и независимые черновики.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Источник вычисляется из выбранного режима
decisions.choice: Отдельные поля черновика допустимы; effectiveSource idea=none. Проверка дубликата, review и команда читают один effectiveSource.
decisions.alternative: Обнулять все поля при каждом переключении: лишняя потеря ввода.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Сохранённый ввод не перезаписывается
decisions.choice: Коллизионно безопасный draft ID и гидратация; immutable pending create payload; reconcile неизвестного результата перед изменённым повтором.
decisions.alternative: Повторить создание с новыми данными под старым ID: смешивает два намерения.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Первый value — ясный контекст и следующий шаг
decisions.choice: Existing: sourced orientation. Idea: собственная цель и сохранённый следующий шаг без вымышленной истории. Отдельно измеряем первый полезный возврат.
decisions.alternative: Считать созданные Project/Task активацией: это только setup.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Учить на реальной работе, разрешать пропуск
decisions.choice: Создано / просмотрено / применено / пропущено различаются. Помощь возобновляет точный проект. Учебные данные отдельно и исключены из рабочих счётчиков.
decisions.alternative: Обязательная учебная задача на главной доске: шум и ложная работа.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Настройка исполнителя по потребности
decisions.choice: Нет выбранного исполнителя = незаполненная роль, не Provider later. Context/manual path работает без подключения аккаунта; агент нужен перед реальным Run.
decisions.alternative: Сразу проходить весь provider/account/admission каталог: блокирует первый value.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Общий scoped read model без чужих fixtures
decisions.choice: Home, Live, Pulse и cycles получают только разрешённые наблюдения; пример открывается явно и имеет отдельный dataset. Empty/unknown/stale различаются.
decisions.alternative: Переименовать Atlas/Studio: маскирует утечку тестовых данных.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Один resolver для контекста и один reducer ввода
decisions.choice: Селектор над полем показывает назначение. Шорткат уважает область либо явно переключает её. Непустой текст не теряется: добавить/заменить с Undo.
decisions.alternative: Шорткат молча перезаписывает текст: потеря намерения.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Атрибуция меняется типизированной командой
decisions.choice: Task и Board имеют разные типы entityRef; исходный origin неизменяем. Отсутствующая ссылка показывает missing/denied, не другой разговор.
decisions.alternative: Убрать коррекцию совсем: допустимый временный выключенный control до handler, не окончательное решение.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Оператор задаёт результат, система исполняет механику
decisions.choice: Spawn/deliver/checker являются наблюдаемыми backend-этапами. Оператор видит действие/ожидание/исключение; проверка и полномочия не обходятся.
decisions.alternative: Спрятать кнопки без автоматического перехода: тупик.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Отложенное внимание имеет условие возврата
decisions.choice: Следующий ручной разбор по умолчанию либо выбранный срок. Без напоминания — отдельный выбор; повторные показы не дублируют тему.
decisions.alternative: Later без объяснения когда вернётся: вопрос исчезает из рабочего цикла.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Голос — реальный ввод с понятным результатом
decisions.choice: Первый пример — одно поддержанное намерение. Compound даёт план/частичный исход, не притворяется выполненным; capture→оригинал→правка→journal→command.
decisions.alternative: Демо-транскрипт как R0 voice: не подтверждает работу устройства/STT.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Прочитано относится к показанному снимку
decisions.choice: Rendered snapshot receipt фиксирует cursor; поздние события остаются непрочитанными. Существующее leaving-ack применяется только к видимому snapshot.
decisions.alternative: Текущая длина history: неверна при late/backfill событиях.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Повторение включается после понятного полезного действия
decisions.choice: R0 preset сохраняется paused; показываем timezone, next due, бюджет, host requirement, результат и pause. Desktop закрыт — новых запусков нет.
decisions.alternative: Обещать автономную ночную работу без daemon: ложное ожидание.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Приглашённый приходит в существующую работу
decisions.choice: Отдельный вход: роль, область видимости Estate, назначенная работа. Не заставлять создавать проект, не обещать project-only ACL.
decisions.alternative: Маскировать Estate-wide доступ фильтром проекта: неверная граница.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Прогрессивная помощь без сокрытия возможностей
decisions.choice: Product shell ≠ 85-item review catalogue. Поиск/помощь/точные ссылки доступны всегда; подсказка одна и контекстная.
decisions.alternative: Жёсткое открытие функций по дням/уровню: блокирует опытного пользователя.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.

decisions.title: Приёмка по реальному результату и слоям доказательств
decisions.choice: Source, pure test, prototype click, native integration, observed user outcome хранятся раздельно. Полный проход R0 нужен до runtime readiness.
decisions.risk: Решение проверяется указанными packet acceptance; не является runtime receipt или принятым ADR.
